consume(((bytes32,uint256),(address,uint.details: Only useable by portals / recipients of messagesEmits `MessageConsumed` when consuming messages

params._epoch: - The epoch that contains the message we want to consume
params._leafIndex: - The index at the level in the epoch message tree where the message is located
params._numCheckpointsInEpoch: - The number of checkpoints in the partial proof whose root this consume verifies against. The caller's witness path must have been built against the epoch tree padded to that number of real checkpoints.
params._path: - The sibling path used to prove inclusion of the message, the _path length depends on the location of the L2 to L1 message in the epoch message tree.

params._epoch: - The epoch to fetch the root data for
params._numCheckpointsInEpoch: - The number of checkpoints in the partial proof whose root to fetch

returns._0: bytes32 - The root of the merkle tree containing the L2 to L1 messages

params._epoch: - The epoch to fetch the roots for

returns._0: bytes32[] - The roots stored for this epoch.

hasMessageBeenConsumedAtEpoch(uint256,ui.details: - This function does not throw. Out-of-bounds access is considered valid, but will always return false

params._epoch: - The epoch that contains the message we want to check
params._leafId: - The unique id of the message leaf

insert(uint256,uint256,bytes32).details: Only callable by the rollup contractEmits `RootAdded` upon inserting the root successfullySuccessive inserts for the same epoch with larger `_numCheckpointsInEpoch` values do not disturb earlier entries, so users with witnesses built against an earlier partial proof can still consume them.

params._epoch: - The epoch in which the L2 to L1 messages reside
params._numCheckpointsInEpoch: - The number of checkpoints the inserting proof covered in this epoch. Must be in [1, MAX_CHECKPOINTS_PER_EPOCH].
params._root: - The merkle root of the tree where all the L2 to L1 messages are leaves

consume(((bytes32,uint256),(address,uint.notice: Consumes an entry from the Outbox

getRootData(uint256,uint256).notice: Fetch the root data for a given epoch and partial-proof depth.          Returns 0 if no proof has been inserted at that depth.

getRoots(uint256).notice: Fetch every root stored for a given epoch. The returned array has          MAX_CHECKPOINTS_PER_EPOCH entries; slot `i` holds the root for          `numCheckpointsInEpoch = i + 1`, or zero if no proof of that depth has been inserted.

hasMessageBeenConsumedAtEpoch(uint256,ui.notice: Checks to see if an L2 to L1 message in a specific epoch has been consumed

insert(uint256,uint256,bytes32).notice: Inserts the root of a merkle tree containing all of the L2 to L1 messages in an epoch         after a proof covering the first `_numCheckpointsInEpoch` checkpoints of that epoch lands.
